title: Doesn't fit the jar ring
text: Doesn't fit the jar ring. I tried everything to get this plastic cruet lid to fit into the mason jar ring and it just will not fit. My son tried it, and he couldn't get it to work either. I changed rings, using both mason and ball, thinking that might make a difference, but it doesn't. Good idea, but very poor quality. It's also non-returnable, so it went into the trash. Glad it wasn't much money.

product_metadata.title: Jarware Plastic Regular Mouth Jars, Black Oil Cruet
features: UPGRADE YOUR MASON JARS: Transform the classic Ball Mason Jar into an Elegant Oil Cruet and Dispenser with no drip spout and convenient plug lid.
EASY TO CONTROL SPOUT: Perfect for drizzling healthy oils over salads, pastas, breads and more!

WORKS WITH MANY JARS: Compatible with Ball, Quattro Stagioni, Kilner, Bernardin and Kerr Regular Mouth Mason Jars! Recommended jar size: 16 oz. (jar not included). Ensure the lid is properly snapped on to stay in place
DURABLE DESIGN: This oil cruet is BPA free and constructed of durable nylon and silicone material. It's also dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.
MEASUREMENTS: This attachment weighs 0.64 ounces and has dimensions of 2.64 x 2.64 x 1.97 inches.
description: Transform your mason jars into a new stylish and unique oil cruet!
